description: Answers "Who hosts this company's email, and is it configured properly?" and "Which SaaS tools does this company use?". Profiles a domain from live DNS and its website: MX records and the inferred email provider (Google Workspace, Microsoft 365, …), SPF and DMARC configuration and policy, services the domain has verified ownership with (from TXT records: Google, Microsoft, Stripe, Atlassian, …), whether the website is reachable over HTTPS, and stack and security headers (Server, X-Powered-By, HSTS, CSP). Use it for lead enrichment, email deliverability checks, vendor due diligence or security reviews. You are only charged when a result is returned: invalid input (400) and upstream failures (4xx/5xx) are not settled. Costs $0.004 USDC per call via x402. Paid per call with x402 inside MCP (see the server instructions).

domain.description: Domain to profile, e.g. example.com. A full URL is accepted; its hostname is used.
